CREATE TABLE `ns_authors` (
				`_id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,

				`_createdAt` DATETIME(3) DEFAULT NULL,
				`_updatedAt` DATETIME(3) DEFAULT NULL,
				`_permissions` MEDIUMTEXT DEFAULT NULL,
				`name` VARCHAR(128),  `pages` INT,  `score` DOUBLE,  `tags` JSON,  `bio` VARCHAR(512),  `active` TINYINT(1)
			)

CREATE TABLE `ns_authors_perms` (
				`_id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
				
				`_type` VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL,
				`_permission` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
				`_document` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL
			)

CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE `ns_authors_f5ab0a953dd0508a_fts` USING fts5(bio, content="ns_authors", content_rowid="_id")

CREATE TABLE `ns_books` (
				`_id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
				`_uid` VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
				
				`_createdAt` DATETIME(3) DEFAULT NULL,
				`_updatedAt` DATETIME(3) DEFAULT NULL,
				`_permissions` MEDIUMTEXT DEFAULT NULL,
				`authorId` VARCHAR(64),  `title` VARCHAR(128),  `pages` INT
			)

CREATE TABLE `ns_books_perms` (
				`_id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
				
				`_type` VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL,
				`_permission` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,

			)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX `ns__books__index1` ON `ns_books` (`_uid` COLLATE NOCASE)

CREATE TABLE `ns_reviews` (
				`_id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
				`_uid` VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
				
				`_createdAt` DATETIME(3) DEFAULT NULL,
				`_updatedAt` DATETIME(3) DEFAULT NULL,
				`_permissions` MEDIUMTEXT DEFAULT NULL,
				`authorId` VARCHAR(64),  `stars` INT
			)

CREATE TABLE `ns_reviews_perms` (
				`_id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
				
				`_type` VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL,

			)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX `ns__reviews__index1` ON `ns_reviews` (`_uid` COLLATE NOCASE)
